current_enablement.future_binding_review_required: Bind the actual successful probe receipt/job/publication and its exact source version. Any subsequent source/parser/schema revision must update and re-review these exact pins; do not enable the present draft using a failed probe.

api_review.finding: Original AI is loaded at AI from its byte-pinned executed entrypoint. The returned AI context and globals are not relabelled or monkey-patched. Original AE/AG preflight and retained acceptance readers are reused.

ai_snapshot reconstructs and reads the original AI accepted owner under AI identity, then checks its published receipt binding, full-owned audit, full 21 artifact inventory and evidence/install trees.

dependency_inventory takes all 142 original AG dependency rows plus both accepted owner bindings, validates all 21 artifact paths per row, then selects exactly 141 Geometry dependencies. No two-pin substitution.
The new spec supplies project_sources[TARGET].all_imports matching the exact three published imports; the actual original function accepts these arguments and enforces no-build direct readiness.

Parameter order and spec fields match the immutable definitions. run_owner performs original normal_one and audit calls; completed-owner reads validate the current normal context and full audit before publishing any owner binding.
Probe, installer wrapper, formal wrapper, direct readiness and final stock reads reconstruct the exact argv and check exit zero, project cwd, log path, log fingerprint and original diagnostics.

identity_chain: The actual successful probe must be v2 with fixed corrected source, original AJ source, AK failed receipt, precise scope, successful serialized command and unchanged context.
Installer and runner load the same full publication commit, source and adapter identity; installer bytes are checked against that same publication.
The separate installation receipt must be unique, terminally successful, preserve its pre-install source backup when applicable, and match before/after original-context and Git records.
Normal and audit receipt validation is anchored to the same formal publication and exact 362-known/142-active source context.
The final read requires the unique formal RESULT/WORKER pair, successful serialized wrapper, exact direct-readiness and final-stock command records, same script and unchanged context/Git.
A no-output probe or successful source install cannot set new_owner_accepted; the dispatcher sets it only after successful formal worker completion and terminal preservation checks.

retry_and_readonly_boundaries.result_preservation_after_attempt_alloca: Both workers save WORKER_RESULT on preparation exceptions. Dispatch saves terminal RESULT/SOURCE_INSTALL_RESULT and GIT_AFTER on post-allocation setup failure when evidence writes are available.
retry_and_readonly_boundaries.pre_attempt_hold_boundary: Invalid/unbound inputs and pre-attempt read-only preflight failures return structured HOLD on stdout; they do not allocate an acceptance attempt.

limitations: This is a static architecture/API review of the exact frozen files. It is not an actual successful probe, source installation, normal compile, full-owned kernel audit or acceptance readback.
INPUTS is deliberately None. Current source/probe binding remains closed pending the actual successful source revision and receipt.
The preimage/atomic-write protection is assessed from code and existing test definitions; no source installation was executed by this reviewer.
